name: from_mut_bytes_unchecked
declaration: unsafe fn from_mut_bytes_unchecked (value : & mut [u8]) -> & mut Wtf8
documentation:
Creates a mutable WTF-8 slice from a mutable WTF-8 byte slice.

 Since the byte slice is not checked for valid WTF-8, this functions is
 marked unsafe.
rules: The bytes in `value` must be valid WTF-8 when calling `Wtf8::from_mut_bytes_unchecked`.
